findings.title: ICE detains two US citizens protesting outside White Memorial Hospital, rapid response groups say
findings.exact_supporting_passage: we diverted ambulances to nearby hospitals for about two hours to ensure every patient received timely care.
findings.access_consequences: Adventist Health White Memorial temporarily rerouted incoming ambulances to nearby hospitals for approximately two hours after federal agents formed a line across its ambulance entrance. Hospital said it did not authorize the blockade. No complete ED closure established and diversion had ended.
findings.affected_population: Patients requiring ambulance transport to Adventist Health White Memorial and emergency patients in the Boyle Heights catchment area; exact patient count unknown.
